rejected_candidates.analyst_note: Analyst review of the collected Dependabot PR #226: the bot proposed widening scrapelib's urllib3 requirement, but the PR was closed without merging and its body does not connect the proposal to a downstream friction event. Copied upstream release notes are not scrapelib remediation.

Analyst review of the collected Dependabot PR #226: the PR describes a proposed version-range update, not a concrete failure, incompatible environment, or migration task in scrapelib. The error/fix language belongs to copied upstream urllib3 release notes and does not establish downstream friction.
